shared_or_similar_visual_information: A gray-filled portion of a plane diagram. On the left, use the selected gray unit cells of the four-by-four grid. On the right, use the blue-green fill under the right branch of the semicircle, to the right of x = 3.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The cells marked gray specify a finite collection of occupied squares of the candidate shape. Right image: It selects the region under the arch only from x = 3 to x = 6.
Rationales: The left fill identifies a discrete collection of movable or occupied cells. The right fill identifies a continuous region up to a plotted boundary, requiring a graph-based area calculation.
